notes: v0.2 condition 6: the seed's dev layout (terrain, start, heading, beacon) with only its obstacles replaced by an out-of-distribution family — paired with nominal on the same start and goal. Sensors are nominal.

corridors_v0: three parallel 15-long walls one cell apart across the start-goal line, each with a 1-cell gap 3-6 cells off the line on alternating sides (thread the 1-wide corridors or go round the band's open ends); deadends_v0: a wide U facing the start between start and goal plus six narrow dead-end alleys; detour_v0: one 15-long barrier across the start-goal line shifted off-centre, no gap (go round an end).

every OOD layout is checked: start and goal walkable, goal reachable, min_shortest <= shortest <= max_shortest. layouts.structure_stats() measures what changed (dead-end cells, corridor cells, detour ratio).
no OOD structure cuts the map in two: a full barrier turns hidden search into sweeping one's own half first and puts every baseline at the floor (tried in the v0.2 dev probe).
